sn22.47:1.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ attānaṃ samanupassamānā samanupassanti sabbe te pañcupādānakkhandhe samanupassanti etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ.
sn22.47:1.4: idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī …pe… sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.47:1.5: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.47:1.9: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.47:2.1: iti ayañceva samanupassanā asmīti cassa adhigataṃ hoti.
sn22.47:2.2: asmīti kho pana bhikkhave adhigate atha pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ avakkanti hoti
sn22.47:2.4: atthi bhikkhave mano atthi dhammā atthi avijjādhātu.
sn22.47:2.5: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa asmītipissa hoti
sn22.47:3.1: tiṭṭhanti kho pana bhikkhave tattheva pañcindriyāni
sn22.47:3.2: athettha sutavato ariyasāvakassa avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjati
sn22.47:3.3: tassa avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā asmītipissa na hoti
sn22.47:3.6: na hoti na bhavissantipissa na hoti
